0x001BA1.en: 「I can win, right?/ Surely, probably, maybe, I guess...」

0x001BF1.en: 「Now then, which weapon should I try?」

0x001C22.en: 「Guess I've just gotta do it now.」

0x001C59.en: 「Well... let's just give it a shot.」

0x001CFF.en: 「You never know who'll win till you try.」

0x001D3C.en: 「I struck first, so I've got the edge!」

0x001DB6.en: 「Brother! Your way is wrong!/ I don't understand you anymore!」

0x001E39.en: 「Stop it, brother!/ What good does this do!?/ It only spreads more chaos!」

0x001F04.en: 「I'm sorry... I'm so sorry, brother.../ It's because I built the Duraxil...」

0x001F7B.en: 「No, brother!/ Taking responsibility like this.../ There has to be another way!」

0x001FF6.en: 「Brother, can't I stop you anymore!?/ Can't I be of any help!?」

0x002064.en: 「You disappoint me, General Kirkus!/ When I heard you'd raised your banner,/ I actually had some hope!」

0x0020F4.en: 「You falling this deep into ambition/ wasn't in my data./ I'll have to correct that.」

0x002184.en: 「Of all people,/ trying to prop up that Terius.../ Monica'd be better than him!」

0x00220B.en: 「Whoa... I can tell just by looking./ That's some outrageous tuning./ General, you spared no expense.」

0x00229B.en: 「To give a mass-produced Browel/ this much tuning...../ I'm impressed, General Ort.」

0x002331.en: 「Looks like there's Elial Kingdom/ parts used here and there...../ Wonder how much that cost.」

0x0023BE.en: 「Um.../ right, Major Kanzort Jog./ Special forces... gotta be careful.」

0x002445.en: 「Major Kanzort Jog./ Special forces...../ Definitely no pushover.」

0x0024BA.en: 「I've got your data, Major Jog!/ Prepare yourself!」

0x00251C.en: 「So he's already got a counter/ to ectoplasm processing./ Fighting's just a waste.」

0x002597.en: 「This isn't the time to be dealing/ with someone like Louzorl...」

0x0025FC.en: 「Attacking him now/ won't mean much... eh, whatever.」

0x002667.en: 「Nasel Zamboss... special forces too, huh...../ Looks a bit tough.」

0x0026D2.en: 「Can't deny I'm short on data...../ but I've got to do it!」

0x00271F.en: 「Major Nasel Zamboss./ Special forces through and through,/ so I've barely got any data...」

0x0027A6.en: 「Honestly...../ how you were picked as a mech operator/ still baffles me!」

0x002821.en: 「Ahmed,/ you seem to know a lot of inside stuff?/ Spill some of it!」

0x002899.en: 「Why are wind-element operators/ always such flaky types!」

0x002901.en: 「Ratel!/ You don't want this fight either, right!/ Just quietly back off!」

0x002985.en: 「I thought you'd be a bit more/ reasonable than this,/ Ratel!」

0x0029E8.en: 「Kirkus has poisoned you too much, Ratel!/ Let's stop this fight!」

0x002A53.en: 「Ensign Lioness,/ aren't you acting on personal feelings?」

0x002AA6.en: 「Ensign Lioness!/ I won't hold back, so be ready!」

0x002AFC.en: 「Data says she was once a fine/ police officer...../ but as an operator, how good is she!?」

0x002B86.en: 「Sealing Volkruss completely.../ shows just how amazing/ Sword-God Randor really was.」

0x002C1C.en: 「Super-ancient civilization, giants'/ residual thoughts...../ Need to dig into how true that is.」

0x002CA9.en: 「Ugh, up close it's really gross...../ but as research material, kinda interesting.」

0x002D26.en: 「A precious chance to gather data./ Gotta record it properly.」

0x002E85.en: 「Th-this is bad...../ took a bit too much damage.」

0x002FFD.en: 「Agh!! Shield's in the red zone!?/ I'm in a pinch!!」

0x0030E4.en: 「Ngh!!/ Cranking the power up this high...../ Impressive, General Ort.」

0x003153.en: 「No way!? It took this much!?/ You're kidding!?」

0x0031A9.en: 「Guh!!/ I knew I shouldn't have taken on/ something like a Nagizzard!」

0x003215.en: 「Agh!! No good!/ A power contest is bad for me!」

0x00325F.en: 「C-could you go a little easier,/ Ahmed!」

0x00339A.en: 「You did it! I won't forgive you!」

0x0033CE.en: 「Ngh! Not yet, I won't let you!!」

0x003442.en: 「Not bad! But I can still go!」

0x003476.en: 「Ow!?/ Hey! You're paying for repairs later!」

0x00357D.en: 「Ngh... it's the Duraxil all right./ Fighting head-on is bad for me...」

0x0035E5.en: 「Owww.../ You're better than I thought, General Kirkus.」

0x00362F.en: 「Y-yeah, well, that's what/ sparing no expense on the tuning gets you...」

0x00368B.en: 「Ow! He's onto my every move.../ Should've guessed - special forces.」

0x0036F0.en: 「Oww... geez,/ I don't have time to deal with you!」

0x003752.en: 「Ugh! What is with this guy!/ Nothing but relentless attacks!」

0x0037A8.en: 「Tch,/ dodging Solgady's attacks really is rough.」

0x00382F.en: 「Ngh! Ensign Lioness, not to be taken lightly.」

0x00386C.en: 「Tch, against Volkruss/ getting off this light is downright lucky.」

0x003915.en: 「Heh, not as tough as I thought.」

0x003A22.en: 「Heh heh heh... just as planned!/ This much won't even scratch me!」

0x003A84.en: 「Whoa!/ Took a hit from the Duraxil/ and got off this easy? Lucky me!」

0x003AF6.en: 「That's all your prized machine can do?/ General Kirkus!」

0x003B46.en: 「I've done some upgrades too, you know!」

0x003C10.en: 「Took me for a Norse, did you? Bad move, Ahmed!」

0x003CB2.en: 「Huh? Less damage than I predicted.../ Boosting the armor paid off.」

0x003D70.en: 「Watch it!/ Hey, what if that had hit me?!」

0x003E56.en: 「Phew, that's my brother for you./ Your spot-on aim really saved me.」

0x003EA6.en: 「Whoa, too close~./ Didn't know General Kirkus was this good.」

0x003F05.en: 「General Ort's habits? Already got you figured out!」

0x003F45.en: 「Knew it, I figured you'd try that,/ Major Jog!」

0x003FE2.en: 「Fast, I'll give you that./ But a miss means nothing,/ Ahmed.」

0x004085.en: 「I won't fall for that, Ensign Lioness!」

0x004131.en: 「Yikes!/ Nasty attack you've got there~./ Good thing it missed...」

0x0041AC.en: 「I see, I see./ This dodge pattern works!」

0x004209.en: 「Uh, counter, counter.../ Aw, I've got no usable weapon.」

0x004259.en: 「Attacking from out of range?!/ Hey! That's cheating!」

0x0043BD.en: 「Tytti! Let me in on this too!」

0x0043F7.en: 「Leave the finish to me, Yang Long!」

0x0044A9.en: 「Not thrilled about it, but I'll help,/ Christoph.」

0x0044F6.en: 「Never thought I'd end up helping you,/ Saphine.」

0x0045C7.en: 「Fellow mech lover!/ I'll help you, Ryusei!」

0x0046FA.en: 「A bit nervous, but... I'll shield you!」

0x00473D.en: 「I'll be the shield!/ ...not sure I'll hold, though.」

0x004811.en: 「Um... I, I guess I came to help, Mio.」

0x0048A4.en: 「Not that I care, really,/ but you're an ally, I guess.」

0x0048F1.en: 「Ugh, why do I have to be/ the one saving Saphine...」
